content.value: Find the internal energy of 1 kg of steam at 20 bar in the following cases: i. When the steam is wet having a dryness fraction of 0.9, and
ii. When the steam is superheated and its temperature is 400°C. Assume the specific heat of superheated steam is as 2.1 kJ/kg.K.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2025
